source.edition: KE Protezioni Solari – Price book 10 Bioclimatic, 31.03.26 rev.01

priceBasis: List prices excl. VAT (general conditions p116), EXW for sales abroad. Pergola tables = freestanding structure price in standard colour at standard height 250 cm; motor (one per module) and remote control are mandatory but NOT included. Wall-mounted variants are derived by subtracting the printed 'price decrease for wall installation' from the freestanding table.

products.pages: 15-39 (overview 16-21, tables 22-39); automation 74-75; technical column 66; Classic 76-77; LED 108-109; heaters 112-113; colours 114-115
products.description: Self-supporting bioclimatic pergola with motorised rotating aluminium louvres, perimeter beam with integrated gutters, no visible screws; modular in width (L) and projection (SP); wind class 6 (EN 13561).

variants.notes: Price table on p23 (KE axes: rows = P/SP sporgenza, cols = L larghezza; '1L' configuration page p22). mountType freestanding: the table price is the freestanding (4-post) price as printed. limits.notes: Per module per KE: L (larghezza/width) max 450 cm, SP (sporgenza/projection) max 611 cm (p8, p16, tables). Max area 27.5 m2 per module (p8). Standard H 250 cm, up to 300 cm with +EUR 131/post. Multi-module maxima: 2L L884, 2P SP1206, 3L L1318, 3P SP1801, 4 = 884x1206, 6L = L1318 x SP1206, 6P = L884 x SP1801, 2SC = L600 x SP511 (no intermediate pillars). uncertainties: Customer spec '611 cm wide x 450 cm projection' is the opposite orientation of KE's own labels (L/width max 450, SP/projection max 611, p8/p16). I kept KE's axes for freestanding and L-side wall variants and swapped axis tags only for SP-side wall variants (wall along the 611 edge). Confirm with the customer which side goes against the wall.

Wall-mounted variants are DERIVED (table minus printed wall decrease), not printed tables. Decreases: 1L 1791/1791; 2L L2429/SP1791; 2P L1791/SP2429; 3L L3066/SP1791; 3P L1791/SP3066; 4 L2429/SP2429; 6L L3066/SP2429; 6P L2429/SP3066; 2SC L1791 only (p22-38).

Config names for wall variants not shown in the overview pages (e.g. 2L table with wall on SP side, 2P with wall on L side, 3L/3P/6L/6P cross cases, 2SC wall) are my descriptive names; the price pages do show both 'placed-against side' diagrams and decreases for them.

B/C gutter surcharge interpretation: right-hand '**B/C' column (keyed by SP) and bottom '**B/C' row (keyed by L) read as price per one side of that length ('** Attention price per one side'). Stored per variant in gutterBCSurchargePerSide.

Overview p18/p20 footnote '* COLONNA OBBLIGATORIA OLTRE. 700 CM PER MODULO' (column mandatory beyond 700 cm per module) – not applicable to Skylife's 611 cm max as printed; likely copied from Prime. Not modelled.
Special configuration 'single module with back-set frontal pillars' (p21) is 'on quotation' but also says 'ADD EUR 403,00 compared to 1L'; captured as an option.
Sensor prices (p75) are listed per motor family (KE cable KEW / KE radio KER / Somfy Altus RTS / Somfy IO Sunilus); KE cable KEW motor itself is not priced on Skylife pages.

Colour list: p115 places CORTEN ROUGH in the +4%/+2% surcharge group although product pages show it as a STANDARD swatch; RAL 9005 Black Matt is surcharge-free on p115 but not among product-page standard swatches.
LED strip prices (p108) use a length header (side length in cm) with breakpoints 250..750; assumed 'round up to next breakpoint'. Strips longer than 750 cm not priced.

uncertainties: Customer spec '600 cm wide x 450 cm projection' is opposite to KE labels (L/width max 450, SP/projection max 600). Same handling as Skylife: SP-side wall variants have axis tags swapped.
Customer spec height max 300 cm, but the PDF says max 270 cm (p8 'H.max 270' and note under every Neos table).
Neos price rows (projection) are in odd steps of 17.5 cm (210.8, 228.3, ... 595.8, 600); 2P rows in 35 cm steps (415.2 ... 1185.2, 1200). Kept exactly as printed (decimal cm).
p101 (Neos 2P) row labels printed '4852', '5552', '8002', '8352' are typos for 485.2/555.2/800.2/835.2 cm (verified visually: decimal point missing in the PDF itself); corrected.

Wall-mounted variants are DERIVED (table minus decrease): 1L 827 (L) / 827 (SP); 2L 1902 (L only); 2P 827 (L) / 1902 (SP); 2SC 603 (L only; lower than the 1L decrease – as printed p102). 1T loft has no decrease.
Neos 1L page p96 shows only the 'placed-against side L' diagram but prints decreases for both L and SP sides; overview p94 shows both 1L A variants.
Products Summary p8 lists Neos fastener 'freestanding/wall/roof' and column profile '13x13 / 13x19,5'; '1T loft' mapped to no_legs (no posts, fixed to building on surface-mounted bracket, p104).
Sensors (p75) are listed for Somfy Altus RTS / Sunilus IO rows; Neos uses Altus 40 RTS / Sunea Screen IO motors – compatibility assumed by protocol (RTS/IO) but not stated; confirm with KE.
No B/C gutter options and no RGB LED for Neos (p108 'no KEDRY NEOS').
